name: Rallly
description: Rallly is an open-source scheduling and collaboration tool designed to make organizing events and meetings easier.
composeYaml:
services:
  rallly_db:
    image: 'postgres:14.2'
    volumes:
      - 'rallly_db_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data'
    environment:
      - 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}'
      - 'POSTGRES_USER=${POSTGRES_USER}'
      - 'POSTGRES_DB=${POSTGRES_DB:-rallly}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - 'pg_isready -d $${POSTGRES_DB} -U $${POSTGRES_USER}'
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 15
  rallly:
    image: 'lukevella/rallly:latest'
    platform: linux/amd64
    depends_on:
      rallly_db:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      - 'DATABASE_URL=postgres://${POSTGRES_USER}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@rallly_db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-rallly}'
      - 'SECRET_PASSWORD=${RALLLY_PASSWORD}'
      - 'NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=${APP_URL}'
      - 'ALLOWED_EMAILS=${ALLOWED_EMAILS}'
      - 'SUPPORT_EMAIL=${SUPPORT_EMAIL:-support@example.com}'
      - 'SMTP_HOST=${SMTP_HOST}'
      - 'SMTP_PORT=${SMTP_PORT}'
      - 'SMTP_SECURE=${SMTP_SECURE:-false}'
      - 'SMTP_USER=${SMTP_USER}'
      - 'SMTP_PWD=${SMTP_PWD}'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "bash -c ':> /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/3000' || exit 1"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 20s
      retries: 10

meta.about: Create polls to vote on dates and times (alternative to Doodle).
